terms.gloss: send word that it is off: cancel
evidence: Plaut. Stich. 4.2.19: jubē domī cēnam coquī atque ad illum renūntiārī (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: to retract, revoke, give up, renounce. Of a dinner one has accepted, to send word that one will not come (Plautus); of a friendship or an agreement, to call it off (Cicero, Livy).
Lewis & Short: to lay aside, give up. For a plan one simply drops.
Classically to repeal a law or take away an office (Lewis & Short): for what an authority cancels, not for a dinner.

phrases.english: Grandma has called off dinner; she’s ill.

sources: Lewis & Short: renuntio · Lewis & Short: omitto · Lewis & Short: abrogo
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. cancel.
